summary: Account has 8 followers, 6 posts, high reel views but steep early drop-off and zero DMs. Data too thin to confirm patterns; need consistent posting and hook testing.
guidance:
- Hook style to try next: Problem-Agitate-Solve or Behind-the-Scenes showing chatbot build process.
- Avoid repeating "24-hour delivery" and "Rs 1499" in every post; vary value props.
- Posts must show real work (code snippet, live demo) not generic ad copy.
- High skip rates (64-75%) mean first 3 seconds fail; open with visual proof of problem solved.
- Share rate on presenter reel (51%) suggests collaboration format works; replicate with chatbot demo.
- View sources mostly feed/profile; add explore-friendly hashtags and location tags.

instructions.research: Find 3 Himachal hotels/cafes with poor website chat support; note their pain points.
instructions.analysis: Compare skip rates of two reels; identify first 3 seconds that caused drop-off.
instructions.writer: Draft a 60-second reel script: hook with a real chatbot fail, demo your AI fix, end with WhatsApp CTA.
instructions.image: Create a carousel: slide 1 - hotel site without chat, slide 2 - your chatbot mockup, slide 3 - pricing Rs 2999.
instructions.video: Record screen capture of chatbot responding to 'room availability' query; keep first 3 seconds dynamic.

manual_tips: Comment on 5 local hotel/cafe Instagram posts with genuine feedback about their website.
Reply to any story mentions or tags from collaborators (editorxyz_official).
Post a story showing today's chatbot development progress with a poll: 'Which feature matters most?'
